dct_description_sm: This dataset contains information from a study evaluating how dietary treatments influence uterine inflammation in heifers. It includes diet details, feed intake, and health indicators such as body condition score, vaginal discharge, uterine cytology, and blood immune measures collected at multiple time points (hours and days).
dct_title_s: Dataset for: Dietary modulation of uterine inflammation in dairy heifers
